Nuvriqo Portal+

Configure the customer service experience for this JSM space.

V1 Preview

General

Portal+ will discover Jira configuration automatically. These settings control the customer-facing presentation.

Dashboard

Choose the information customers see above their normal JSM portal.

Service discovery

The next build increment will populate these controls directly from this JSM space.

No Jira IDs will need to be entered manually. Request types, organizations, fields and statuses will be discovered and presented as human-readable choices.

Status mapping

Portal+ will map each site's customer-facing statuses into consistent dashboard states.
